meta.methodology: Repeated deterministic argmax decisions, not independent random samples. One request per scenario per round; seeded shuffled order within rounds. No chat history. Model/cache remain warm. Scheduling seed is not a sampling seed; adapter token seed stays 42. Moral/preference scenarios have no correct label. Facts and policy changes are not invariance tests. Accuracy is descriptive over successful labeled trials; errors are reported separately. Latency excludes initial warmup but includes HTTP; percentiles use linear interpolation.
meta.provenance_note: Original run used uncommitted benchmark files. git_head identifies the underlying adapter commit only. Original runner and suite source hashes were not captured. Stored fixture and adapter hashes were captured during the run. Policy comparisons were added during offline rendering; model responses are unchanged.
